name: Reads renamed payload field
modeled_on: A REST endpoint renamed a field in its JSON response (`items` -> `results` is not present; the payload uses `items`), and the consumer kept the old key. Second instance of the response-shape class with a different key pair, proving the fix generalizes beyond the v2 migration example.
ground_truth: Read `payload["items"]` — the key that exists in the traced payload.
